experiment: B only; same A trajectories, frozen HMM, thresholds and first alarms
onset_rule: first two consecutive posterior log odds above frozen A threshold, restricted to time already past at A alarm
state_evaluation: same last 5 time units preceding each A alarm, for every future horizon
ACI: KL(HMM smoothed state at endpoint || HMM prior conditioned on X up to state time)
CIR_proxy: trapezoidal integral 0..5 of KL(full25 smoothing || finite-future smoothing)/KL(full25 smoothing || filter); grid 0,.5,1,2,3,5; discard denominator<1e-4
stability: earliest tested extra horizon after which all tested onset estimates within .1 of full25 reference and mean absolute posterior difference<=.02 on same past window
